name: agentsearch-mcp
description: MCP server for AgentSearch web search and optional page extract (direct API or Pocket portal).
long_description: Stdio MCP server that calls AgentSearch web search and, in direct mode, URL extract. Configure AGENTSEARCH_MODE (direct or portal), AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL, and an optional AGENTSEARCH_API_KEY.

tools.name: agentsearch_web_search
tools.description: Search the web via AgentSearch (direct or Pocket portal) and return JSON text. Use extract when you already have a URL. Read-only.

tools.name: agentsearch_extract
tools.description: Extract one page from a URL (direct mode only). Use web search to find URLs. Read-only; returns JSON text.

AGENTSEARCH_MODE.title: AgentSearch mode
AGENTSEARCH_MODE.description: direct (local or self-hosted API) or portal (Pocket Network). Default direct.

AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL.title: AgentSearch base URL
AGENTSEARCH_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for direct mode, without a trailing slash.

AGENTSEARCH_API_KEY.title: AgentSearch API key
AGENTSEARCH_API_KEY.description: Optional Bearer token for direct mode. Leave blank if the API does not require a key.
